messages.text: Happy to. Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup you already run? And roughly what do you pay for power?
0.06 kwh.  not my first miner.  after a miner with a high hash rate available in stock
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s miner

Highest hashrate we can actually ship you: the GekkoScience KBOX, 22 TH/s at 330 W, $800. At 6¢ that's about $14 a month in power. It's built in the US with about a 19-day lead time.

Next one down in stock is the Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at 166 W, $369 — roughly $7 a month.

Want the KBOX, or is $800 more than you had in mind?

My ceiling could go as far as 1500%.  What about multiple Thor P2 units.  If I was to get 3 Thor P2 units.  They would spread the luck of finding a block right.  What do you have about 800$ and are the Thor P2's in stock

Three Thor P2s give you 30 TH/s total for $1,107 — ships October 3, 2026. Honest bit: block odds track total hashrate, so 3×10 TH isn't luckier than one 30 TH box, but it is more hashrate than the KBOX's 22 TH, and three boxes means three things to place and power (about 500 W, ~$22/month at 6¢).

Around $800, the KBOX is the one in stock. Want me to build the three Thors?
What pre orders miners do you have on the way with slots available

Two with slots open right now.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W — Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026. Best value per TH we sell; about $28/month at 6¢.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at ~360-450 W — Batch 5, ships November 30, 2026. About $17/month.

Honest bit: both are manufacturer builds and dates have moved before. With a $1,500 ceiling, the 40T is my pick. Want it in the cart?
